findings.title: Conditional-serialize predicate misnamed, so website_name is always serialized
findings.body: File app/serializers/user_serializer.rb defines `def include_website_name` without a question mark, while ActiveModel::Serializer looks for `include_website_name?` (as used for every other attribute like include_email?, include_stats?). The misnamed method is never called, so website_name is serialized even when `website` is blank, returning null and wasting payload, and the intended gating does not work.

findings.title: website_name bypasses TL0 anonymous hiding for website
findings.body: File app/serializers/user_serializer.rb adds :website_name to `attributes` but does not add it to `untrusted_attributes`, which is what suppresses bio/location/website for TL0 users seen by anonymous via dynamically defined include_?_methods. As a result an anonymous viewer who is denied `website` will still receive `website_name` derived from it, leaking a profile field that was intentionally hidden.

findings.title: Untrusted-attributes test not updated for website_name
findings.body: File spec/serializers/user_serializer_spec.rb line 11 lists untrusted attributes without website_name, so the test `doesn't serialize untrusted attributes` cannot catch the leak where website_name remains visible for TL0 users seen as anonymous. The list must include website_name to lock in the privacy contract.
